Name: Mall Road
Description: Main street of Murree with shops cafes restaurants hotels and street vendors. Perfect for evening strolls souvenir shopping and people watching. About 25 km long.

Name: Kashmir Point
Description: Most scenic viewpoint in Murree offering panoramic views of Kashmir mountains and surrounding valleys. About 1 mile walk from GPO. Popular for picnics photography and pony rides.

Name: Pindi Point
Description: Famous viewpoint offering breathtaking views of Rawalpindi and Islamabad twin cities. Has a chairlift ride for tourists. Great for families and adventure lovers.

Name: Patriata (New Murree)
Description: Also known as New Murree. Famous for Pakistan's longest chairlift (7km) and cable car system. At 7500 feet altitude with dense forests. Monkeys and leopards can be spotted.

Name: Ayubia National Park
Description: Haven for hikers and wildlife lovers. Famous Pipeline Track connects Ayubia to Dunga Gali. Scenic 4km trek with views of Himalayas. Features chairlift stunning valleys and diverse wildlife.

Name: Bhurban
Description: Famous for Pearl Continental Hotel luxury resorts golf courses and scenic walking trails. Blend of luxury and natural beauty. Home to Murree Wildlife Park with various animal species.

Name: Sozo Adventure Park
Description: Renowned spot for thrill seekers with roller coasters water slides rock climbing zip lining and amusement rides. Great for families and kids of all ages.

Name: Ghora Gali
Description: Former British colonial retreat retaining vintage charm. Features a chairlift ride and stunning mountain views. Peaceful and less crowded than main Murree areas.

Name: Jhika Gali
Description: Small picturesque town with wooden cottages and slanted roofs. Popular in winter for snow viewing and summer for cool weather. Perfect for family vacations.

Name: Murree Hills
Description: Beautiful mountain terrain at 2286 meters above sea level. Famous for pine trees fresh air and panoramic views. The Queen of Hills offering hiking photography and nature walks.

Name: GPO Chowk
Description: Historic colonial-era General Post Office at the heart of Murree. Symbol of the town heritage and a central landmark from where most attractions are accessible.

Name: Murree Brewery
Description: One of the oldest breweries in Pakistan established in 1860. Historic building with colonial architecture. Important cultural and historical landmark of Murree.

Name: Chattar Park
Description: Family friendly park on the way to Murree with boating play areas and lush greenery. Perfect for a quick picnic stop. Great for children and families.
